mechanism_narrative: A rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% over the past 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which increases corporate costs and reduces profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE decreases > 0.5% in 3 months and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Real Final Sales of Domestic Product (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases > 1% MoM and 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 2% over the past 3 months signals a contraction in supply, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as companies face production constraints and reduced output.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases > 2% in 3 months and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and the number of nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increases by more than 200,000 in a month, it signals a strong labor market and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS increases > 200,000 and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% month-over-month and real final sales (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% month-over-month, it signals robust demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 5% MoM and RSAFS increases > 1% MoM
failure_condition: If HOUST increases > 5% MoM and RSAFS increases > 1% MoM and 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, when the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) is above its 12-month moving average and GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 2% year-over-year, it signals supply constraints and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO > 12-month MA and GDPC1 YoY < 2% and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
